body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Paris, France. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 10 km. It starts at Musée Rodin, Rue de Varenne, 77. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Musée Rodin. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Kseniya as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Dive into the depths of France's capital with this in-app audio tour, crafted for travelers fascinated by history and architecture. Discover Paris at your own pace, starting at the Musée Rodin and concluding within the verdant embrace of the Jardin des Plantes. This journey is a gateway to the city's soul, combining the ease of technology with the allure of bygone eras.
>
> The tour's path weaves through Paris's grandeur, from the reflective gardens and artistic splendor of the Musée Rodin to the regal might of the Luxembourg Palace. It traverses the Seine via the ornate Pont Alexandre III, cuts through the literary corners of Shakespeare and Company, and navigates the exalted hallways of Louvre Museum. Start your adventure at the doorstep of the Musée Rodin, and prepare to be led through captivating narratives until reaching the living tapestry of the Jardin des Plantes. Feel the weight of history with each step, in places like the Panthéon and Notre-Dame Cathedral, and let the whispers of the past guide you through Paris's rich cultural landscape. This audio guide offers a unique passage through time, revealing vivid memories encapsulated within the city's enchanting monuments and streets.
>
> Although admission to the Musée Rodin is included, there is no guided tour available for the museum. You're welcome to explore it at your own pace.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.35. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 519 ratings and 180 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.
